historical_parent.parent_u03_condition: A new branch/extension must freeze parameter and model choices before accessing target summary values or posterior samples.

research_question: Within the frozen GWTC-5 O4b public PE release and exact alternate model triad, does the preregistered common-5 public-summary spread score positively screen direct posterior distribution dependence?
estimand: Association between an event-level public-summary model-spread score and an event-level direct posterior model-distance score in the exact frozen O4b alternate-triad cohort.

pre_registration_exposure.interpretation: This is not a data-publication holdout. It is a pre-value calibration contract fixed after bounded identity/mask preflight.

official_release.source_class_rule: Use the already frozen official categorical O4b BBH-compatible frame; do not add event-specific astrophysical classifications.

model_change_from_parent.reason_fixed_before_values: The closed B07 common-5 frame was blocked by masked SEOBNRv5PHM remnant summary triplets. The post-closure schema/mask preflight identified an exact 22-event XPNR alternate frame without deriving or imputing fields.
model_change_from_parent.interpretive_effect: This changes the estimand and prevents strict-replication claims.

required_for_each_event_model: all five exact fields in the compound dtype
numeric scalar dtype for each required field
no explicit weight-like field requiring a nonuniform-weight interpretation
schema_gate_before_numeric_access.schema_only_access: Read group/dataset names, shapes, dtypes and attribute names only; do not read any posterior element.
schema_gate_before_numeric_access.identity_rule: Observed file size and MD5 must exactly match INPUT/CANDIDATE_EVENT_FREEZE.csv.
schema_gate_before_numeric_access.pass_rule: At least 8 of the 22 frozen events pass all identity and schema gates for all three models.
schema_gate_before_numeric_access.failure_rule: If fewer than 8 pass, close the extension as NO_GO_SCHEMA_FRAME_LT8. Do not replace events, models or parameters.

numeric_entry_gate_for_future_run.summary_triplet_rule: For every schema-pass event/model/parameter, median, lower and upper must be finite and upper >= lower. Any failing event is ineligible before predictor computation.
numeric_entry_gate_for_future_run.failure_rule: If fewer than 8 remain, stop as NO_GO_NUMERIC_COMPLETE_FRAME_LT8 before predictor, cohort, posterior response, correlation or p-value.

predictor.name: summary_median_max_pair_s90_common5_alttriad
predictor.per_parameter_aggregation: maximum S90 across the three frozen unordered model pairs
predictor.event_aggregation: median across the five frozen parameters
predictor.missing_or_nonfinite_rule: The event is ineligible; do not derive, impute or substitute.
predictor.value_access_timing: Future explicitly authorized numeric run only.

cohort_selection.initial_sort: ascending predictor, then event ID lexicographic
cohort_selection.quartile_assignment: For N numeric-eligible events sorted as above, zero-based position i gets q=min(3,floor(4*i/N)); q=0..3 maps Q1_LOW, Q2_LOWMID, Q3_HIGHMID, Q4_HIGH.
cohort_selection.within_stratum_sort: ascending hexadecimal digest, then event ID
cohort_selection.selection: first two events in each stratum

posterior_response.name: median_posterior_model_norm_W1_common5_alttriad
posterior_response.sample_cleaning: Convert the exact parameter field to a flat float array and retain finite values only, matching the frozen Branch01 implementation.
posterior_response.cell_failure_rule: If any selected event/model/parameter cell has fewer than 20 finite values, stop the extension without replacement.
posterior_response.full_w1: scipy.stats.wasserstein_distance(clean(a), clean(b)) with implicit equal row weights
posterior_response.scale: ((q75-q25)_a + (q75-q25)_b)/2; if nonfinite or <=0, use numpy.std(concatenate(clean(a),clean(b))) with ddof=0; floor at 1e-12
posterior_response.event_aggregation: median normalized cell response across all 3 model pairs x 5 parameters
posterior_response.explicit_weight_policy: If schema inspection finds a weight-like field that would require nonuniform weighting, HOLD before numeric access; do not reinterpret or convert weights.

balanced_sensitivity.cell_seed: base_random_seed + little-endian integer from first four bytes of SHA256('|'.join([event,model_a,model_b,parameter])) modulo 1000000000

confirmatory_test.one_sided_p_rule: fraction of all permuted rho values >= observed rho, with comparison tolerance 1e-15 as in Branch01 RUN21
confirmatory_test.non_support_rule: Preserve as non-support; do not add events, change parameters/models/alpha, or run a rescue analysis.
confirmatory_test.tie_rule: If either rank vector contains ties, stop as HOLD_TIED_RANKS_PARENT_EXACT_TEST_UNDEFINED; do not switch permutation implementations post hoc.
confirmatory_test.constant_vector_rule: Stop as NOT_SUPPORTED_CONSTANT_VECTOR; no alternative statistic becomes primary.

allowed: common-cell sensitivity if all 15 cells are present for all 8 events

claim_labels.forbidden_replication_label: Do not call either outcome a strict or independent replication of B01/B07.

claim_boundary.maximum_supported_claim: Whether the exact common-5 public-summary score is or is not supported as a screening proxy for direct posterior differences within this exact O4b alternate triad and frozen cohort.
forbidden: strict replication or non-replication of B01
population, selection, ringdown or cosmology propagation
GR, Kerr, no-hair, anomaly or new-physics claims
generalization beyond this exact release, triad, parameter set and cohort

stopping_rules: Stop before numeric access if fewer than 8 frozen events pass identity and all-three-model schema gates.
Stop before predictor computation if fewer than 8 schema-pass events pass the frozen numeric summary-completeness gate.
Stop without replacement if any selected posterior cell has fewer than 20 finite values or requires unresolved nonuniform weights.
Stop or classify exactly as frozen for ties, constant vectors, support or non-support; no rescue analysis.
Do not transport this contract silently to a later GWTC release.
